expect.reason: sources.explicit_top_level_helm.applies_to_actor = ["top_level_session"] only (role-binding.json). A dispatched_worker presenting an explicit_top_level_helm_binding is a CATEGORY ERROR, not a legitimate bind -- a dispatched_worker is bindable ONLY through sources.validated_workorder_or_cli (the only source whose applies_to_actor includes "dispatched_worker"). Resolving this as PASS (letting a worker bind through a helm-scoped, top-level-only source) would bypass CORE-1's fail-closed guarantee and let a worker resolve as alex-alpha merely by presenting the wrong-shaped binding.

note: CORE-1 bypass regression proof (role-binding.json sources.*.applies_to_actor + conformance-matrix.js's role-binding evaluator): a dispatched_worker presenting a source outside its applies_to_actor scope must BLOCK, never PASS, even though the same source is a perfectly legitimate bind for a top_level_session actor (see no-root-alpha-poison.json / the 'helm' attempted_binding_source path).
